Get ready to groove to the electrifying beats of "Galatta" from "Aavesham", Sung by Paal Dabba & Sushin Shyam, Lyrics Written by Vinayak Sasikumar, Music Composed by Sushin Shyam. Written and Directed by Jithu Madhavan. Produced by Nazriya Nazim & Anwar Rasheed. Hit that play button now and get ready to be blown away
In cinemas from April 11 2024
